boundary_note: Molins-del-Rey, frozen span 1808-12-21 to 1808-12-21. Replacement boundaries unset; phases are research hypotheses. This draft admits no features, changes no frozen winner and allocates no tactical or campaign credit.

claims.value: Bodart: side A (French and allies) 12,800 infantry and 1,200 cavalry, total 14,000; side B (Spanish) 13,000 infantry and 2,000 cavalry, total 15,000.
claims.rationale: Available-for-engagement figures under Bodart’s rounded-up convention (shared research-conventions index), unless the entry specifies a surrender population. Not an opening muster; components are not added twice. English rendering of the claim-relevant portion (ours): "side A (French and allies) 12,800 infantry and 1,200 cavalry, total 14,000; side B (Spanish) 13,000 infantry and 2,000 cavalry, total 15,000."

claims.value: Bodart lists side A under Saint-Cyr and side B under Caldagués.
claims.rationale: Printed attribution does not establish uninterrupted command over this date span or automatic individual credit. English rendering of the claim-relevant portion (ours): "French-side command: Saint-Cyr; opponent-side command: Caldagués."

claims.value: Toreno gives side B no more than 10,000 infantry and 900 cavalry reassembled after Cardedeu, with numerous artillery.
claims.rationale: Reassembled pre-battle army, differing from Bodart’s 15,000; no subtraction of prior losses or inferred total of guns. English rendering (ours): "Across the river the Spaniards reassembled their army; after the defeat of the 16th and dispersion it did not exceed 10,000 infantry and 900 cavalry, with numerous artillery."

citations.locator: toreno-t2, printed p. 261, Internet Archive leaf 266; inspected page-image excerpt
citations.quote: Al otro lado habian reunido los españoles el suyo que con la derrota del 16 y dispersion que ella causó en todas las tropas no ascendia arriba de 10,000 infantes y 900 caballos con artillería numerosa.

claims.value: Toreno records side A reinforced by five Chabran battalions before reaching the Llobregat.
claims.rationale: Reinforcement component only. No assumed battalion size or complete French battle total. English rendering (ours): "His army reinforced with five battalions of General Chabran’s division."

citations.locator: toreno-t2, printed p. 261, Internet Archive leaf 266; inspected page-image excerpt
citations.quote: reforzado su ejército con cinco batallones de la division del general Chabran.

claims.value: Toreno places Gómez de la Serna on the Spanish right, Cuadrado on the left, and Reding with Caldagués in a redoubt.
claims.rationale: Specific field roles, not a resolution into Bodart’s sole Caldagués attribution. English rendering (ours): "Brigadier Gaspar Gómez de la Serna commanded the right, Field Marshal Cuadrado the left; Reding and Caldagués stayed in a redoubt on the Valencia road."

citations.locator: toreno-t2, printed p. 262, Internet Archive leaf 267; inspected page-image excerpt
citations.quote: Mandaba la derecha el brigadier D. Gaspar Gomez de la Serna, la izquierda el mariscal de Campo Cuadrado, manteniéndose Reding juntamente con Caldagués en uno de los reductos que habian levantado en el camino real de Valencia.

claims.value: Toreno says Vives arrived at ten in the morning only to witness the destruction of his troops.
claims.rationale: Retrospective clock and outcome rhetoric, not independently synchronized. His superior title does not show presence during the opening attack. English rendering (ours): "At ten in the morning Vives arrived only to witness the destruction of his men."

citations.locator: toreno-t2, printed p. 262, Internet Archive leaf 267; inspected page-image excerpt
citations.quote: A las diez de la mañana llegó Vives solamente para presenciar la destruccion de los suyos.

claims.value: Saint-Cyr assigned Chabran to attract enemy attention at the bridge while masking his troops.
claims.rationale: A contingent task under Saint-Cyr; not evidence Chabran independently commanded the operation. English rendering (ours): "Chabran was placed at Molino del Rey to keep attracting the enemy’s attention there, masking his troops as far as possible."

citations.locator: saint-cyr, printed p. 81, Internet Archive leaf 85; inspected page-image excerpt
citations.quote: Chabran fut placé à Molino del Rey, pour continuer d’attirer l’attention de l’ennemi sur ce point; il devait masquer ses troupes, autant qu’il le pourrait

claims.value: Toreno dates the French attack to dawn on 21 December, with Pino and Souham fording the Llobregat.
claims.rationale: The same page names the two fording divisions. A later Spanish defensive counterstroke does not change the main offensive posture. English rendering (ours): "At dawn on the 21st the enemy began the attack."

citations.locator: toreno-t2, printed p. 262, Internet Archive leaf 267; inspected page-image excerpt
citations.quote: El enemigo al alborear del 21 empezó su ataque.

claims.value: Side B held an entrenched position on the Llobregat’s right bank, on the Ordal foothills from San Vicente to Pallejá.
claims.rationale: Held entrenchments are supported; their construction authority and replacement phase remain unresolved. English rendering (ours): "The Spanish army was entrenched on the Llobregat’s right bank in the Ordal foothills, extending from San Vicente to Pallejá."

citations.locator: toreno-t2, printed p. 262, Internet Archive leaf 267; inspected page-image excerpt
citations.quote: El ejército español estaba atrincherado en la márgen derecha del Llobregat, en las colinas en que rematan las alturas de Ordal, extendiéndose desde San Vicente hasta Pallejá.

claims.value: The Spanish entrenched position lay on the right bank and hills of the Llobregat.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "The Spanish army was entrenched on the Llobregat’s right bank in the Ordal foothills."

open_questions: Reconcile the reassembled Spanish army and French five-battalion reinforcement with dated returns, and distinguish Vives’s superior authority from Reding/Caldagués on the field.
Deferred: the dated original returns and reports identified above, and any deeper source-lineage reconciliation. No additional research cycle follows merely from this gap.

Source dependence: Bodart is a later compilation. Toreno, Foy, Oman, Saint-Cyr and the official Correspondance are interested or retrospective source families, and embedded/reprinted reports are not extra independent witnesses. Agreement does not establish independence.
